title: Garcia: Poll converting Naga into HUC ‘will not be a walk in the park’
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The outcome of Naga City’s upcoming plebiscite on its proposed conversion into a highly urbanized city (HUC) remains uncertain, Commission on Elections (Comelec) Chair…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The outcome of Naga City’s upcoming plebiscite on its proposed conversion into a highly urbanized city (HUC) remains uncertain, Commission on Elections (Comelec) Chair George Erwin Garcia said on Thursday. Garcia said the plebiscite “will not be a walk in the park,” as either the “Yes” or “No” vote could prevail. He stressed that both supporters and opponents of the proposal should be given the opportunity to explain their positions. “It will be explained to those who do not agree with YES why it should be a highly urbanized city.
